intro:
Denver's mile-high economy has become a magnet for relocating tech workers and the companies chasing them: aerospace and defense along the Front Range, telecoms headquartered here since the cable era, renewable energy programs scaling across the Mountain West, and a startup scene fed by quality-of-life migration. Project roles split accordingly — PMP for aerospace and energy programs, Scrum credentials for the tech corridor from RiNo to Boulder. Live online batches run year-round with sensible Denver timings — a full Saturday–Sunday weekend cohort plus a midweek Wednesday–Thursday option — so you train during comfortable local daytime hours; the schedule table below lists every upcoming date with its exact Denver start and finish. The package is unchanged regardless: live weekend instruction, exam application support, full-length mock exams, and trainer access until you clear.

Denver's project demand climbs with its skyline: aerospace and defense programs along the Front Range, telecom headquarters, and the energy and outdoor-industry corporates that relocated for altitude and talent. Federal-adjacent work brings certification requirements with it, and the commercial side has followed. Training is live online across two consecutive days shown in Denver local time on this page — no I-25 commute for a classroom.
